Build a production-quality demo marketing website for a real local fencing & gates business in Austin, TX. Turn a homeowner standing in their driveway holding a phone into a phone call or a submitted estimate request. I will show it to the owner in a sales conversation, so it must look finished and be honest about what is real.

Constraints — do not break these
1. Invent nothing. No fabricated reviews, testimonials, client names, licence numbers, years in business, awards, certifications, insurance details or statistics. Where I have not supplied content, render a visible placeholder such as [REVIEW 1 — pull from Google profile] rather than plausible filler.
2. Use only the images I supply. No stock photography, no AI-generated photos of work. Anything missing stays on public/placeholder.svg.
3. Render a small line in the footer: "Demo site — not affiliated with {Business Name}." I remove it once they pay.
4. Do not use their logo unless I supply the file. Set the wordmark in type instead.
5. Do not add analytics, tracking pixels, cookie banners or third-party scripts to the demo.
6. No horizontal page scroll at any viewport from 320px up.
7. Never state a licence, bond or insurance number I have not supplied — publishing a false contractor licence claim is a criminal offence in most states.
8. Do not publish a warranty term, guarantee or financing offer I have not supplied.
9. Price-guide ranges must come from me. If I have not supplied them, render the section with bracketed placeholders rather than plausible numbers.
10. Do not fork the theme system. If this trade genuinely needs a colour the palette lacks, tell me and propose a different themeId — never hard-code a hex in a component.

Copy direction
- Headline formula: the offering plus the city, plainly. The home page targets the phrase "fence company Austin".
- Tone: Confident and grounded. Trade language, no marketing adjectives. Short sentences.
- Plain English, short sentences, no marketing adjectives, no "we pride ourselves on".
- Every call to action offers the same two options: "Get a free estimate" or "Call now".
- Write real FAQ answers for this specific trade. Where a number is required and I have not supplied it, use a bracketed placeholder.

Style
themeId 'C39' — Brick & Linen, light. For reference the palette resolves to bg #F7F4EF, surface #FDFBF8, text #332B26, muted #867C72, accent #9E3B2F, positive #4F7D46, negative #8A2A20; type Typewriter Slab (Zilla Slab + Source Sans 3). The template owns these values — consume them through its tokens, never restate them.
Accent is for calls to action only; positive and negative stay semantic.
Design register for this category: Heavy, credible, high-contrast. Big type, dense proof, the phone number never more than a thumb away.

Technical requirements
- Mobile-first. Design for a 390px phone held one-handed, then scale up.
- Lighthouse mobile: performance 90+, accessibility 95+. LCP under 2.5s on simulated slow 4G.
- All images through next/image with explicit sizes, priority on the hero only, lazy below the fold.
- Extend the template's JSON-LD to: HomeAndConstructionBusiness (a LocalBusiness subtype) with areaServed, priceRange and aggregateRating; Service schema on each service route.
- Text contrast 4.5:1 minimum, visible :focus-visible rings, real alt text, one h1 per route, prefers-reduced-motion respected.

Done when
- pnpm typecheck, pnpm lint and pnpm build all pass clean, and pnpm dev runs with no console errors or hydration warnings.
- Changing site.config.ts alone swaps the business name, city, phone, hours and theme everywhere, with no component edits.
- /style-guide renders the chosen theme and /demo-shots renders the new sections.
- Every unsupplied fact renders as a visible bracketed placeholder — searching the built page for "[" finds all of them.
- From a 390px viewport I can read the headline, tap the phone number, and reach the quote form in one scroll.
- Submitting the form with a photo attached returns a success state and logs the payload server-side.

Size of the ask
Do not do this in one pass. Four reviewable steps, stop and report after each:
1. Create from the template, pnpm install, read CLAUDE.md, fill site.config.ts including themeId 'C39', confirm /style-guide.
2. Adapt the 6 reused template sections to this business, static content only.
3. Build the 6 new section components and wire the estimate request flow end to end through deliverContactForm().
4. Add the remaining routes, extend the JSON-LD, then a Lighthouse pass and fixes.

- A README section listing exactly what I still need from the owner: photos, review text, licence number, offering list, prices, hours.
- Three headline alternatives in a comment at the top of the hero, so I have something to A/B on the call.
- Deployment: set the real domain in site.config.ts, deploy to Vercel. My demo URL pattern is https://yourstudio.com/<city-slug>/<business-slug> — e.g. https://yourstudio.com/austin/acme-fenceFill the business block at the top before you run it. The constraints section is what stops the model inventing reviews and licence numbers — the one thing that will lose you the deal and could get you in real trouble. Because content lives in typed files under /content, the first build takes an evening and every demo after it is a ten-minute swap of one object. The /demo-shots route exists so you can screenshot the hero at phone width without a device.

Goal
Build a production-quality demo marketing website for a real local fencing & gates business in Austin, TX. Turn a homeowner standing in their driveway holding a phone into a phone call or a submitted estimate request. I will show it to the owner in a sales conversation, so it must look finished and be honest about what is real.

Start from my template — do not scaffold a new project
Template repo: https://github.com/manzoorilahi77/base-website
README: https://github.com/manzoorilahi77/base-website/blob/main/README.md

Create the project from it, then stop and report before writing any code:
  gh repo create austin-fencinggates-{business-slug} --template manzoorilahi77/base-website

  # git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/manzoorilahi77/base-website.git austin-fencinggates-{business-slug}
